presentation.label: FINE TUNE + SAMPLE RATE
presentation.summary: TUN turns in cents, press and turn for semitones; FIN's knob can become RATE, pure sample speed down to a stop and into reverse. Tap the knob to switch.
presentation.overview: Fine Tune + Sample Rate gives a sample's pitch and speed finer control on the SAMPLE page. TUN turns 1 cent a step, faster as you spin it; press and turn for whole semitones, which keep the cents. The value reads +3.07, and whole semitones read as stock. The cents are kept in TUN itself, so a saved sound plays the same pitch on stock OS, which only shows the whole number. RATE is a pure speed control: switch it on for a sound with SMP RATE in SOUND SETTINGS, or tap FIN's knob, and FIN's knob reads RATE, +63 to -64: +63 plays at normal speed, 0 stops, -64 plays backward at normal speed, in a straight line between them, as the Octatrack's RATE with its setting on PTCH. Stock's pitch stops at a quarter of the speed. A trig below 0 starts from END. The setting saves with the sound and is off by default.
highlights: Tune a sample in cents: turn TUN, press and turn for semitones.
Fine tuning saves in the sound itself and plays the same on stock OS.
Slow a sample to a dead stop and run it backward from one knob.
Exactly the Octatrack's range: +63 is 1x, 0 stops, -64 is -1x.
Switching between FIN and RATE is instant, with no dip in speed or slide in pitch.
Works beside LOP PIPO from Pipo Loop, without needing it.
usage: Press SMPL and turn TUN slowly: it moves 1 cent a step and reads +0.01, +0.02. Spin it faster to cover more ground.
Press TUN's knob and turn: whole semitones, the cents kept.
Put a long sample on a track, with LOP ON. Tap encoder B: FIN's knob reads RATE. Play the pad and turn RATE down from +63: the sample slows like a stopping turntable and rests at 0.
Keep turning below 0: it runs backward, smoothly through the stop. A new trig now starts from END.

access.location: SAMPLE page: TUN (encoder A) for fine tuning. For RATE, SOUND SETTINGS: SMP RATE, under SMP:, or tap FIN's knob (encoder B).
steps: Select a track whose sound plays a sample, and press SMPL.
Turn encoder A (TUN) for cents; press and turn it for semitones.
Tap encoder B: the knob reads RATE and the value stays where it was unless FIN was +0, which goes to +63.
Or press FUNC + FILTER, choose SOUND SETTINGS, go to SMP RATE and press RIGHT: the box is checked.

controls.name: TUN
controls.doc: SAMPLE page, encoder A. -24.00 to +24.00 semitones. A plain turn moves 1 cent a step, with acceleration; press and turn moves whole semitones and keeps the cents. FUNC + turn jumps -24, 0, +24 as stock. Held trigs' locks take cents the same way. Whole values read as stock (+3), others with two places (+3.07).

controls.name: SMP RATE
controls.doc: SOUND SETTINGS, under SMP:. OFF: stock. ON: FIN is RATE on this sound. Saved with the sound. Switching on takes FIN +0 to RATE +63; switching off takes RATE +63 to FIN +0; other values stay.

controls.name: Tap of encoder B
controls.doc: SAMPLE page. A short press with no turn turns SMP RATE over. Not with a trig, FUNC or NO held, or a pad held in scene or performance mode, and not in running live recording.

controls.name: RATE
controls.doc: SAMPLE page, encoder B, on a sound with SMP RATE on. +63 to -64: speed scales by |RATE| / 64, backward below 0, and +63 is exactly 1x. TUN still multiplies it. Locks and LFOs reach it as FIN.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.7.

Run on a unit by the author as SP03 to SP13 (0.1.x, TESTING.md); 0.2.0 by the author's automated rig on the unit (TESTING.md). Two voices together, performance and scene locks and sound browser load are from rytm-emu or not run there.
MIDI CC 24 sets TUN in whole semitones and clears its cents, as stock's CC does; NRPN keeps them to 1/128 semitone.
Other screens (LFO destinations, a sound lock's list) and stock OS show TUN as a whole number.
A pattern with TUN locks in cents saves one more lock lane per track, of stock's 72; stock OS loads those locks with their cents.
Saving to and loading from SOUND MANAGER is not confirmed on a unit: stored sounds often gave ERROR there, RATE or not, and one that loaded came back with SMP RATE clear (README).
RATE never goes above 1x by itself; TUN does, to stock's ceiling of about 4x.
On stock OS a saved sound plays FIN as FIN: RATE +63 is about a semitone sharp.
With LOP OFF, once the sample has played out, changing RATE does not bring it back: trig again.
A change of direction on a looping voice waits until it is 32 frames clear of STA and END; a trig does not wait.
LFO destination lists and other screens still say FIN.
Sound locks, scene locks and performance locks on RATE have not been run.

load.display: About 0.8 % of the audio block idle in a 16-module set (0.1.0, measured); 0.1.1 skips it with no track's RATE on
load.conditions: Measured on an Analog Rytm MKII with a private telemetry base, sequencer stopped: removing 0.1.0 from the author's 16-module set lowered the idle block from 72.9 % to 72.1 %. 0.1.0's block handler walked all eight voices every block; 0.1.1 returns at once when no track has RATE on and no voice is still going down. The two gates in the step loop stay, about 10 instructions a voice; with RATE on, the handler and gates run as in 0.1.0.

hardware.summary: npp1993 (the author) flashed test builds SP03 to SP13 on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74, each with Pipo Loop 0.1.1 from its local branch, and reports: the SOUND SETTINGS row and checkbox work; the knob reads RATE on that sound and FIN on others; RATE 1x, slowing to a stop, and reverse; a trig below 0 starts from END; LOP OFF; a locked trig backward and a plain trig forward; LOP PIPO turns with no clicks at fixed RATE and by hand; an LFO to Fine Tune passing through a stop (SP04, after a Pipo Loop fix); kit save and power cycle; track copy; a sound lock onto a row-off track; the tap of encoder B, which flips reliably and fast, and does not flip with a trig, FUNC or NO held, a pad held in scene or performance mode, in running live recording, on a long hold or a press and turn. 0.1.1 (this source) in LF01, the author's 16-module set on a private telemetry base: RATE still slows, stops and reverses, as reported; with Ping Pong Loop's and QPERF's idle fixes the idle audio block fell from 72.9 % to 71.1 %.
limitations: Results are as reported by the author, not itemized measurements; duration not recorded.
LOAD TO TRACK in SOUND MANAGER often gave ERROR on the unit, on sounds with nothing to do with RATE too, and the one load that worked came back with the setting clear; stock was not compared.
Tested with Pipo Loop in the image; this module alone was not flashed.
Not tested on a unit: two voices together, performance and scene locks by ear, CPU load alone.
Final test build SP13 c.f. TESTING.md; firmware was not read back from the device.
0.1.1 ran on a unit only in LF01 (a6d85a85, combined image with a private telemetry base), not alone; its own idle saving was not separated from Ping Pong Loop's and QPERF's.

tests.summary: rytm-emu on OS 1.74, 23,777-frame ramp: rate word exact at every RATE tried, trig below 0 starts from END, row off sample-identical to the core alone, with Pipo Loop no clicks at any speed or across flips and sweeps; the tap's cases. Hardware, as reported by the author: SP03 to SP13, and LF01 (0.1.1 in a 16-module set: RATE works; idle block 72.9 % -> 71.1 % with two other modules' fixes) (TESTING.md).
